2026_03_ATL_GB.headline: Penix’s return changes the equation for Atlanta at Lambeau
2026_03_ATL_GB.paragraph1: Atlanta finally gets Michael Penix Jr. back after an 0-2 start, and his return should let Kevin Stefanski build more of the offense around Bijan Robinson, Drake London and a downfield passing game that never found traction with Cooper Rush. Green Bay is 1-1 after surviving the Jets in overtime, but Jordan Love will operate behind a banged-up line and without Jayden Reed. The central question is whether Atlanta can protect Penix long enough to make Green Bay defend the entire field.
2026_03_ATL_GB.model_rationale: Penix raises Atlanta’s offensive ceiling immediately, but Green Bay still owns the more stable overall setup if its protection holds and Love avoids obvious passing situations.
